metadata.title: Windows Server 2025 Active Directory (AD) Domain Controllers Organizational Unit (OU) object must be configured with proper audit settings.

criterion.comment: Windows Server Active Directory Domain Controllers Organizational Unit (OU) object must be configured with proper audit settings.

independent-def:shellcommand_test.comment: Windows Server Active Directory Domain Controllers Organizational Unit (OU) object must be configured with proper audit settings.

independent-def:shellcommand_object.comment: Query both Fail and Success auditing settings for Domain Controllers Organizational Unit (OU)
independent-def:shellcommand_object.independent-def:command: $domain = Get-ADDomain; $path = 'AD:\' + $domain.DomainControllersContainer; $aud = (Get-Acl $path -Audit).Audit; $hasFail = [bool]($aud | Where-Object {$_.IdentityReference -match 'Everyone|S-1-1-0' -and $_.AuditFlags -eq 'Failure' -and ($_.ActiveDirectoryRights -match 'GenericAll|FullControl|All') -and $_.InheritanceType -eq 'All' -and $_.IsInherited -eq $false}); $hasSuccSelf = [bool]($aud | Where-Object {$_.IdentityReference -match 'Everyone|S-1-1-0' -and $_.AuditFlags -eq 'Success' -and $_.InheritanceType -eq 'None' -and $_.IsInherited -eq $false}); $hasSuccDesc = [bool]($aud | Where-Object {$_.IdentityReference -match 'Everyone|S-1-1-0' -and $_.AuditFlags -eq 'Success' -and ($_.ActiveDirectoryRights -match 'WriteProperty|WriteAllProperties') -and $_.InheritanceType -eq 'All' -and $_.IsInherited -eq $false}); . { $t = $path.Replace('AD:\',''); if (-not $hasFail -or -not $hasSuccSelf -or -not $hasSuccDesc) { $reasons = @(); if (-not $hasFail) { $reasons += 'MISSING: Explicit Everyone : Failure : FullControl [Applies to: All Descendant Objects]' }; if (-not $hasSuccSelf) { $reasons += 'MISSING: Explicit Everyone : Success : Special [Applies to: This Object Only]' }; if (-not $hasSuccDesc) { $reasons += 'MISSING: Explicit Everyone : Success : Write all properties [Applies to: All Descendant Objects]' }; 'Target_Object=' + $t + ' | IdentityReference=Everyone (S-1-1-0) | Status=FAIL | Details=' + ($reasons -join ' ; ') } else { 'Target_Object=' + $t + ' | IdentityReference=Everyone (S-1-1-0) | Status=PASS | Details=All mandatory Failure and Success audit entries and scopes are correctly configured per SV-254404r958732.' } }

independent-def:shellcommand_state.comment: No lines shall exist listed with status of 'FAIL'
